antipatterns.name: God Module
antipatterns.description: Module 'god_module' has excessive efferent coupling (Ce = 7, 58.3% of project dependencies). It depends on too many other modules, making it a change bottleneck.
antipatterns.refactorSuggestion: Split this module into smaller, focused modules with single responsibilities to reduce coupling and improve maintainability.

antipatterns.name: Circular Dependency
antipatterns.description: Circular dependency detected: user_repo → order_service → user_service
antipatterns.refactorSuggestion: Introduce an abstraction/interface, use dependency injection, or move shared logic to a separate common module to break the circular reference.

antipatterns.name: Layer Violation
antipatterns.description: Layer violation in Layered architecture: 'user_repo' (Repository/Model layer) depends on 'order_service' (Service/Logic layer). Dependencies must only flow downward.
antipatterns.refactorSuggestion: Apply Dependency Inversion: introduce an abstraction in the Repository/Model layer that the Service/Logic layer implements, so the dependency flows downward.

antipatterns.name: Layer Violation
antipatterns.description: Layer violation in Layered architecture: 'user_service' (Service/Logic layer) depends on 'admin_controller' (Controller/UI layer). Dependencies must only flow downward.
antipatterns.refactorSuggestion: Apply Dependency Inversion: introduce an abstraction in the Service/Logic layer that the Controller/UI layer implements, so the dependency flows downward.
